title: Bioactive Secondary Metabolites From the Marine-derived Fungus Penicillium steckii SCSIO41025.
authors: Yang, Chun; Chen, Chunmei; Tan, Yanhui; Liu, Yonghong; Zhou, Xuefeng; Tao, Huaming
one_liner_zh: 该文从海洋真菌中分离次级代谢产物并测试其对NF-kappaB的抑制活性，仅涉及小分子与NF-kappaB p65的分子对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: One new glycoside derivative, 9-O-alpha-D-glucose-aspyranochromenone A (1), and 13 known compounds (2-14) were isolated from the marine fungus Penicillium steckii SCSIO 41025. Their structures were established by spectroscopic methods, computational electronic circular dichroism, and single-crystal X-ray diffraction. All of the isolated compounds (1-14) were evaluated for their inhibitory activities against lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced nuclear factor kappa-B (NF-kappaB). Among them, compounds 10 and 11 displayed obvious inhibitory activities against LPS-induced NF-kappaB with IC(50) values of 15.24 +/- 1.08 and 24.91 +/- 1.06 microM, respectively. Furthermore, molecular docking analysis showed a strong binding affinity of compound 11 for the NF-kappaB p65.
abstract_zh: 从海洋真菌Penicillium steckii SCSIO 41025中分离得到1个新糖苷衍生物，9-O-alpha-D-葡萄糖-天冬色原酮A（1），以及13个已知化合物（2-14）。通过光谱方法、计算电子圆二色谱和单晶X射线衍射确定了它们的结构。对所有分离得到的化合物（1-14）进行了对脂多糖（LPS）诱导的核因子kappa-B（NF-kappaB）的抑制活性评估。其中，化合物10和11对LPS诱导的NF-kappaB表现出明显的抑制活性，其IC(50)值分别为15.24 ± 1.08和24.91 ± 1.06微摩尔。此外，分子对接分析显示化合物11与NF-kappaB p65具有强结合亲和力。
